_note: Relics (docs/plans/relics/, phase 5c step 5a; docs/plans/rebuild-phase5c-combos.md, section 10): team-wide, no downsides, in tiers (common, rare, epic, legendary, boss). The whole pool: 44 from step 5a, 20 from 5b, 11 from 5c-1, 11 from 5c-2, and the 3 bond relics from 5d (tier bond: free, only in shops once their duo bond is on). Texts keep numbers out (the UI adds them from the mod and run rules). Icons reuse the placeholder glyphs until the art rehaul. Numbers are placeholders.
